hard_rules: Every visible current edge MUST resolve through edge_sources.csv to source_registry.csv.
Do not parse source_id_original or audit raw files for production edges.
Use org_id/person_id as identity keys; never merge entities solely by display name.
category_id is the semantic display group; cluster_id is a network-community attribute and may be blank.
parent_org_id is only formal sourced hierarchy; blank means unknown/not asserted, not orphan/error.
SONSTIGE is a valid explicit manual-review category and must not be auto-reclassified in the frontend.
G4 history is separate from current edges and MUST NOT be shown as active.
Reconstructed source registry rows are explicitly marked registry_status=reconstructed_missing_registry; do not present their organization homepage URL as an exact citation page.
